parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The ID of the CEN instance. This parameter is required. Create a CEN instance in the CEN console before calling this operation, and ensure that an Enterprise Edition transit router has been created.

parameters.name: FirewallAttachmentZone
parameters.description: The zone ID used by the firewall connection.

parameters.name: FirewallName
parameters.description: The name of the Cloud Firewall instance.

parameters.name: FirewallServiceMode
parameters.description:
The deployment mode of the firewall service. Valid values:

- **PrimaryStandby**: Primary/standby mode.
- **MultiPrimary**: Active-active mode.

> If this parameter is not specified, the system automatically selects a deployment mode based on the capabilities of the transit router. If an invalid value is specified, the error ErrorFwServiceMode (-360437) is returned. MultiPrimary mode does not support specifying zones.

parameters.name: FirewallServiceZones
parameters.description: The list of zone IDs used by the firewall service.

parameters.name: FirewallSubnetCidr
parameters.description: The subnet CIDR block used to store the firewall ENI in the firewall VPC in automatic mode.

parameters.name: FirewallVpcCidr
parameters.description: The CIDR block of the firewall VPC in automatic mode.

parameters.name: FirewallVpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC in which the firewall ENI is created in manual mode.

parameters.name: FirewallVswitchId
parameters.description: The ID of the vSwitch in which the firewall ENI is created in manual mode.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese
- **en**: English

parameters.name: RegionNo
parameters.description: The region ID of the Enterprise Edition transit router. This parameter is required.

parameters.name: RouteMode
parameters.description: The routing mode. This parameter is required. Valid values: managed (automatic mode) and manual (manual mode). In managed mode, you must specify FirewallVpcCidr, FirewallSubnetCidr, TrAttachmentSlaveCidr, and TrAttachmentMasterCidr. In manual mode, you must specify FirewallVpcId, FirewallVswitchId, TrAttachmentSlaveZone, and TrAttachmentMasterZone.

parameters.name: TrAttachmentMasterCidr
parameters.description: The primary subnet CIDR block used to connect to the TR in the firewall VPC in automatic mode.

parameters.name: TrAttachmentMasterZone
parameters.description: The primary zone of the vSwitch.

parameters.name: TrAttachmentSlaveCidr
parameters.description: The secondary subnet CIDR block used to connect to the TR in the firewall VPC in automatic mode.

parameters.name: TrAttachmentSlaveZone
parameters.description: The secondary zone of the vSwitch.

parameters.name: TrAttachmentZones
parameters.description: The list of zone IDs used by the TR connection.

parameters.name: TransitRouterId
parameters.description: The ID of the Enterprise Edition transit router instance. This parameter is required. The transit router must belong to the CEN instance specified by CenId.
